name: Paladin
equipment: (a) a martial weapon and a shield or (b) two martial weapons
(a) five javelins or (b) any simple melee weapon
(a) a priest's pack or (b) an explorer's pack
Chain mail and a holy symbol

styles.name: Blessed Warrior
styles.desc: Two cleric cantrips as paladin spells (CHA); swap one on level up.

styles.name: Blind Fighting
styles.desc: Blindsight 10 ft: see through darkness and blindness, and invisible creatures that aren't hidden.

styles.name: Dueling
styles.desc: +2 damage with a one-handed melee weapon and no other weapon.

styles.name: Great Weapon Fighting
styles.desc: Reroll 1s and 2s on damage dice of two-handed or versatile melee weapons held in two hands (keep the reroll).

styles.name: Interception
styles.desc: Reaction with a shield or weapon: reduce a hit on an adjacent ally by 1d10 + prof.

styles.name: Protection
styles.desc: Reaction with a shield: impose disadvantage on an attack against an adjacent ally.

actions.name: Divine Sense
actions.desc: Know celestials, fiends, undead within 60 ft (and consecrated places)

actions.name: Lay on Hands
actions.desc: Spend points from the pool; 5 points cure a disease or poison

actions.name: Channel Divinity
actions.desc: Oath power, see your Sacred Oath

actions.name: Divine Smite
actions.desc: On a melee hit: spend a slot for 2d8 radiant, +1d8 per slot level above 1st (max 5d8), +1d8 vs undead or fiend

1.name: Divine Sense
1.desc: Action: until your next turn ends, sense celestials, fiends and undead within 60 ft and consecrated or desecrated places; 1 + CHA mod uses per long rest.

1.name: Lay on Hands
1.desc: Healing pool of 5 x paladin level HP per long rest: action, touch to heal from it, or spend 5 to cure a disease or poison; no effect on undead or constructs.

2.name: Fighting Style
2.desc: Pick one: Blessed Warrior, Blind Fighting, Defense, Dueling, Great Weapon Fighting, Interception or Protection.

2.name: Spellcasting
2.desc: CHA half-caster preparing CHA mod + half paladin level spells from the paladin list each long rest; holy symbol as focus.

2.name: Divine Smite
2.desc: On a melee weapon hit, spend a slot: +2d8 radiant, +1d8 per slot level above 1st (max 5d8), +1d8 against undead or fiends.

5.name: Extra Attack
5.desc: Attack twice when you take the Attack action.

6.name: Aura of Protection
6.desc: You and allies within 10 ft (30 ft at 18th) add your CHA mod (min +1) to saves while you are conscious.

10.name: Aura of Courage
10.desc: You and allies within 10 ft (30 ft at 18th) can't be frightened while you are conscious.

11.name: Improved Divine Smite
11.desc: Every melee weapon hit deals +1d8 radiant.

14.name: Cleansing Touch
14.desc: Action: end one spell on yourself or a willing creature you touch; CHA mod uses per long rest.

3.name: Channel Divinity
3.desc: Nature's Wrath: a creature within 10 ft STR or DEX save or restrained by vines. Turn the Faithless: fey and fiends within 30 ft WIS save or turned for 1 min.

7.name: Aura of Warding
7.desc: You and allies within 10 ft (30 ft at 18th) resist damage from spells.

15.name: Undying Sentinel
15.desc: Once per long rest drop to 1 HP instead of 0; no aging.

20.name: Elder Champion
20.desc: Action, 1 min: regain 10 HP each turn, 1-action paladin spells as bonus actions, enemies within 10 ft have disadvantage on saves vs your spells and Channel Divinity; once per long rest.

3.name: Channel Divinity
3.desc: Conquering Presence: chosen creatures within 30 ft WIS save or frightened for 1 min. Guided Strike: +10 to an attack roll after seeing it.

7.name: Aura of Conquest
7.desc: Creatures frightened of you within 10 ft (30 ft at 18th) have speed 0 and take half paladin level psychic at their turn start.

15.name: Scornful Rebuke
15.desc: Creatures that hit you take CHA mod psychic (min 1).

20.name: Invincible Conqueror
20.desc: Action, 1 min: resistance to all damage, one extra attack with the Attack action, melee crits on 19-20; once per long rest.

3.name: Channel Divinity
3.desc: Champion Challenge: bonus action, chosen creatures within 30 ft WIS save or can't move more than 30 ft from you. Turn the Tide: bonus action, creatures within 30 ft at half HP or less heal 1d6 + CHA.

7.name: Divine Allegiance
7.desc: Reaction: take the damage dealt to a creature within 5 ft instead of it.

15.name: Unyielding Saint
15.desc: Advantage on saves against paralysis and stun.

20.name: Exalted Champion
20.desc: Action, 1 h: resistance to nonmagical weapon damage, allies within 30 ft have advantage on death saves, you and they have advantage on WIS saves; once per long rest.

3.name: Channel Divinity
3.desc: Sacred Weapon: for 1 min a held weapon adds CHA to hit, glows and is magical. Turn the Unholy: fiends and undead within 30 ft WIS save or turned for 1 min.

7.name: Aura of Devotion
7.desc: You and allies within 10 ft (30 ft at 18th) can't be charmed while you are conscious.

15.name: Purity of Spirit
15.desc: Always under Protection from Evil and Good.

20.name: Holy Nimbus
20.desc: Action, 1 min: 30 ft sunlight, enemies starting there take 10 radiant, advantage on saves vs fiend and undead spells; once per long rest.

3.name: Channel Divinity
3.desc: Peerless Athlete: bonus action, 10 min of advantage on Athletics and Acrobatics, double carry, +10 ft jumps. Inspiring Smite: after a smite, share 2d8 + paladin level temp HP among creatures within 30 ft.

7.name: Aura of Alacrity
7.desc: +10 ft walking speed; allies starting their turn within 5 ft (10 ft at 18th) gain +10 ft that turn.

15.name: Glorious Defense
15.desc: Reaction when you or a creature within 10 ft is hit: +CHA to its AC, and if it misses you attack the attacker; CHA mod uses per long rest.

20.name: Living Legend
20.desc: Bonus action, 1 min: advantage on CHA checks, once per turn a missed weapon attack hits, reaction to reroll a failed save; once per long rest or with a 5th-level slot.

3.name: Channel Divinity
3.desc: Control Undead: an undead within 30 ft WIS save or obeys you for 24 h (CR below your level). Dreadful Aspect: chosen creatures within 30 ft WIS save or frightened for 1 min.

7.name: Aura of Hate
7.desc: You and fiends and undead within 10 ft (30 ft at 18th) add CHA mod to melee weapon damage.

15.name: Supernatural Resistance
15.desc: Resistance to nonmagical bludgeoning, piercing and slashing.

20.name: Dread Lord
20.desc: Action, 1 min: 30 ft gloom, frightened enemies take 4d10 psychic, shadows give attackers disadvantage on you and chosen allies, bonus action shadow attack 3d10 necrotic; once per long rest.

3.name: Channel Divinity
3.desc: Emissary of Peace: bonus action, +5 Persuasion for 10 min. Rebuke the Violent: reaction, an attacker within 30 ft that hurt someone else WIS save or takes that damage as radiant (half on a success).

7.name: Aura of the Guardian
7.desc: Reaction: take the damage dealt to a creature within 10 ft (30 ft at 18th) instead of it.

15.name: Protective Spirit
15.desc: Ending your turn in combat below half HP heals you 1d6 + half paladin level.

20.name: Emissary of Redemption
20.desc: Resistance to damage from other creatures, and attackers take radiant equal to half the damage they deal you; lost against a creature you harm until a long rest.

3.name: Channel Divinity
3.desc: Abjure Enemy: a creature within 60 ft WIS save or frightened with speed 0 for 1 min (half speed on a success). Vow of Enmity: bonus action, advantage on attacks against a creature within 10 ft for 1 min.

7.name: Relentless Avenger
7.desc: After an opportunity attack hit, move half your speed without provoking.

15.name: Soul of Vengeance
15.desc: Reaction melee attack when the target of your Vow of Enmity attacks.

20.name: Avenging Angel
20.desc: Action, 1 h: 60 ft flying speed and a 30 ft aura that frightens enemies (WIS save), attacks on frightened ones have advantage; once per long rest.

3.name: Channel Divinity
3.desc: Watcher's Will: you and CHA mod creatures within 30 ft have advantage on INT, WIS and CHA saves for 1 min. Abjure the Extraplanar: extraplanar creatures within 30 ft WIS save or turned for 1 min.

7.name: Aura of the Sentinel
7.desc: You and chosen creatures within 10 ft (30 ft at 18th) add your prof bonus to initiative.

15.name: Vigilant Rebuke
15.desc: Reaction when you or a creature within 30 ft passes an INT, WIS or CHA save: 2d8 + CHA force to whoever forced it.

20.name: Mortal Bulwark
20.desc: Bonus action, 1 min: truesight 120 ft, advantage on attacks vs aberrations, celestials, elementals, fey and fiends, hits can banish them (CHA save); once per long rest or with a 5th-level slot.
